load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a local file, URL, or modelzoo prefix into a model module
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint dict to a local file or remote storage backend like S3 or Petrel
load_state_dict: load a state_dict into a PyTorch module with flexible strict matching and missing key warnings
get_state_dict: get the full state_dict of a PyTorch module including wrapped DDP or TTA models
find_latest_checkpoint: find the latest checkpoint file path from a given directory by reading last_checkpoint
